description: List the tokens other chains may send onto Aether over IBC, each with its channel, the cap on how much of it may be on Aether, how much is there now, how much is in flight back out and the room left. A transfer of any other token, or over the room, is refused and the sending chain refunds it: check the room before asking anyone to send USDC (or anything else) onto Aether. Read-only. active=false means this chain has no cap yet.
name: get_inflow_caps

active.description: false: this chain has no inflow cap yet and every token comes in uncapped

cap.description: the most of it there may be on Aether, in base units

channel.description: Aether's end of the channel the token must come over

denom.description: the token as the other chain sends it

inFlight.description: sent back from Aether and not yet settled, in base units; it holds room until its packet is acknowledged or times out

room.description: how much more may come in now, in base units; a transfer over this is refused and refunded on the sending chain

roomDisplay.description: room in whole units, e.g. 4990 USDC

supply.description: how much is on Aether now, in base units

symbol.description: USDC or OSMO when this server knows the token

voucherDenom.description: what it arrives as on Aether

title: Get IBC inflow caps
